augments.description: Get 35 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

augments.description: 10 seconds into combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this 28 seconds into combat. TFT Macao Open, 2024

augments.description: For every Yordle you've unlocked or unlock, gain 6 gold. The Bandle Paths reveal a secret Yordle 10.

augments.description: Your team gains 10% Durability, increased to 13% if the Ionia trait is active.

augments.name: Gain 21 Gold
augments.description: Gain 21 gold.

augments.description: Every 5th attack deals bonus true damage equal to 200% of your Basic Attack Damage.

augments.name: Woven Magic

augments.name: Walk The True Path+

augments.name: Band of Thieves II+

augments.name: Band of Thieves II++

augments.name: Min-Max
augments.description: Gain a Golden Item Remover and 4 random components.

augments.name: Money Monsoon
augments.description: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny +
augments.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 12 gold.

augments.name: Retribution
augments.description: Gain 2 Hand of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice can critically strike with their Abilities.

augments.name: Sweet Treats

augments.name: The Axiomata

augments.name: The Trait Tree
augments.description: Gain 3 random emblems and 3 gold.

augments.name: We Stick Together

augments.name: Win Out
augments.description: When you reach level 9, immediately level to 10 and gain 10 free shop rerolls. Gain 10 XP now.
